sourceDerivedNotes.productAjaxAllWidthStatus: source-derived, not observed by the native producer; the product consumer records its own real peak
sourceDerivedNotes.tocPagination: BookChapterList.kt:89-113 batches only the declared next URLs after the ordered initial page.
sourceDerivedNotes.contentPagination: BookContent.kt:110-135 batches only the declared next URLs after the first page.
sourceDerivedNotes.retry: OkHttpUtils.kt:29-43 returns the first successful response and otherwise the last one, so retry=2 is 1 attempt on 2xx and 3 on non-2xx.
sourceDerivedNotes.headerMapScriptArity: The pinned Rhino host probe dispatches source.getHeaderMap(false) on a source-signature carrier and rejects the zero-argument call; that is host carrier provenance, not Android execution. The collector measures the actual Android script outcomes for all three arities.
sourceDerivedNotes.scriptProbe: The scriptProbe helper action evaluates one fixture-authored script through the real AnalyzeUrl.evalJS/source binding (frozen) and the product's own InProcessSourceScriptRuntime; its result is the script's JSON projection, compared before any diagnostic conversion.
sourceDerivedNotes.freshCarrier: A details step declared carrier=fresh opens a genuinely new product BookSourcePipeline over the same source object/key and the identical stored search hit; the frozen details stage constructs its own AnalyzeUrl per stage call for the same retained book. The source-authored URL-option js reads and increments one O-source counter, so the two actual invocations supply the distinct /1 and /2 selectors without a transport rewrite. The declaration is validated at the corpus boundary and the actual hit reference, pipeline/transport/source/host-state identities, counter and request facts are in the observation value/evidence.
sourceDerivedNotes.urlOptionJs: The URL-option rows keep the selected absolute pre-option address and the original raw option tail; no side rebases or manufactures a transformed URL. The product's same-analysis HTML _extracted path does not run the option js (a measured omission), while a fresh analysis and the JSON adapter do.
